scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Welcome to Prontera,
the beautiful capital of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. If
you have questions or need help finding something in the city, don't hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
欢迎来到普隆德拉，
卢恩·米德加兹王国美丽的首都。
如果您有任何问题，
或者需要帮助寻找城市中的某个地方，
请尽管提问。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市向导

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
您希望我在小地图上
标记这些地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Swordman Association,
which handles Job Changes
to the Swordman class, has
moved to Izlude. This facility
is just an empty building now.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
负责剑士职业转职的
剑士协会已经搬迁至依斯鲁得岛。
这座建筑现在只是一栋空房。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Sanctuary
handles Job Changes to
the Acolyte class, and can
be found in the northeast
corner of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉圣堂负责服事职业转职，
位于普隆德拉的东北角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Chivralry,
which is responsible for
the safety of our capital, is
in Prontera's northwest corner.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
负责首都安全的普隆德拉骑士团，
位于普隆德拉的西北角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Weapon Shop
is located northeast
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
武器店位于中央喷泉的东北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Tool Shop
is located northwest
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中

[普隆德拉向导]
工具店位于中央喷泉的西北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Inns in Prontera are
located both to the east
and west of Prontera's
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉的旅馆分别位于
中央喷泉区域的东侧和西侧。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Trading Post
can be found southeast
from the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
交易所位于中央喷泉的东南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Pub is located
southeast of the fountain,
behind the Trading Post.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
酒馆位于喷泉的东南方，
在交易所的后面。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
If you head north from
the central fountain, you'll
find an empty area in which
both branches of the Prontera
Library can be accessed if you
head towards the east or west.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
如果您从中央喷泉向北走，
会看到一片空地，
向东或向西走即可进入
普隆德拉图书馆的两个分部。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Job Agency is
just southwest of the
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
职业介绍所位于
中央喷泉区域的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Castle is
located at the northern
sector of this city. You can
go to the fields that are north
of Prontera by going through
the castle's rear exit.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉王宫位于本城的北部区域。
您可以穿过王宫的后门，
前往普隆德拉北边的野外。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The City Hall
is located in the
southwest corner
in our city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中
选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
市政厅位于
普隆德拉城的西南角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]

a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]

Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the

scripts.translation:

[普隆德拉向导]
如果您不想在小地图上
显示地点标记，
请让我为您“从小地图上移除标记”。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
魔法和科技的进步
让我们更新了资讯系统，
现在可以在小地图上标记位置，
方便您导航。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
小地图位于屏幕的右上角。
如果您看不到它，
请按 Ctrl + Tab 键，
或点击基本资讯窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
在小地图上，
点击“+”和“-”符号
可以放大或缩小地图。
祝您在普隆德拉城旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Well, adventurer...
I hope your journeys
through Rune-Midgarts
are both fun and safe.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
好了，冒险者...
希望您在卢恩·米德加兹的旅程
既有趣又安全。
